What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Dengar (V)]]: left, the image of [[Dengar (V)]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[Dengar (V) (Errata)]] (holotable commit 53572eb). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/dengar.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/dengar.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
